description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HealthController, which exposes a health check endpoint (/health/db) for verifying PostgreSQL database connectivity. The controller executes a lightweight SQL query ('SELECT 1') and returns a JSON response indicating the connection status, timing information, and error details if any.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: A REST controller exposing an endpoint for checking database connectivity and health status.

classes.name: HealthResponse
classes.description: A static inner class serving as a schema for API documentation, representing the health response structure.

methods.name: dbHealth
methods.description: Performs a database ping by executing 'SELECT 1' and returns a JSON object indicating success, failure, or degraded health status, along with timing and error info.
